Post 1

📉 Barely a scratch on the surface. ASX 200 slipped just 9.3 points or 0.10% to 9,066.70 Tuesday, but the damage underneath was real — growth stocks sold hard while defensives held. Down 1.07% over five days. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

Consumer Discretionary led declines at -1.81%, Telcos fell -1.66%. Energy and Materials bucked the trend, up 1.18% and 0.85% respectively. The split tells the story: commodity strength vs growth fatigue. #ASX #energy #materials

Post 3

🔻 PNI cratered 10.14% to AUD 15.16 — the session's ugliest print. Pinnacle manages money for others; when sentiment sours on asset managers, it hits fast and hard. REA Group shed 4.21% to AUD 169.78. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 6,252.07/oz. Silver at AUD 93.83/oz. With AUD/USD at 0.7164, metals priced in local currency stay elevated — a tailwind keeping Materials in the green while growth stocks bleed. #gold #silver #metals #ASX

Post 5

ASX sits 2.47% below its 52-week high. The line in the sand: can Energy and Materials hold their bid, or does growth-sector selling drag the index lower? Where do you see the index by Friday — retest highs or more downside? #ASX #ausbiz
